integrity: Proof-derived universal theorem and a standalone finite exact-arithmetic checker; finite checks are supplementary and cannot prove infinite statements. No authorship, external audit, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is the sharp evaluation at the path tip, not the full matrix infinity norm. A positive uniform unnormalized head spectral gap suffices for universality; the finite bound quantifies slower mixing separately. The clique formula holds for all finite positive head/path sizes. Prior-art comparison is provisional where older full text was inaccessible.
title: Universal half-mass transition in endpoint Poisson response of path-attached graphs
